detail: A hands-on-keyboard intrusion toolkit on Kaopu Cloud HK (AS138915, a suspected bulletproof host tracked here). The host 38[.]60[.]252[.]110 remains Shodan-visible as of 2026-09-10 (ports 22/80), though VirusTotal does not flag it - so this rests on first-party evidence, hence high rather than confirmed. Contents: a custom Python C2 server plus a state file holding accumulated live implant data; an MSSQL RCE exploit series; a full Windows local-privilege-escalation 'Potato' suite; a bring-your-own-vulnerable-driver kit for disabling EDR; and a chisel tunneller for pivoting. Kaopu's suspected-BPH profile gives the C2 takedown resistance.
